annotations.title: Buy a 7-day Research Pass ($5, up to 300 calls)

description: One x402 payment of $5 returns a pass token that unlocks every paid tool here for 7 days (up to 300 successful calls). Then set the MCP client header "Authorization: Bearer <pass>" or pass _meta["lumen/pass"]. PAID: $5.00, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/pass/week.
